definitions.explanation: A formal instruction or notification issued from a higher authority (government ministry, company headquarters, etc.) to subordinate bodies or personnel.

examples.japanese: {省|しょう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{通達|つうたつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: A directive was issued from the ministry.

examples.japanese: ⟦{本社|ほんしゃ}→本社：09565_honsha⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{通達|つうたつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: A new directive arrived from headquarters.

examples.japanese: {文部科学省|もんぶかがくしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{通達|つうたつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従|したが}って→従う：02059_shitagau⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We will respond in accordance with the directive from the Ministry of Education.

examples.japanese: ⟦{残業|ざんぎょう}→残業：01071_zangyou⟧⟦{削減|さくげん}→削減：11789_sakugen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{関|かん}する→関する：02045_kansuru⟧{通達|つうたつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{全社|ぜんしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{通達|つうたつ}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A directive regarding overtime reduction was circulated company-wide.

notes:
A formal term for official instructions flowing downward through an organizational hierarchy. In government, a {通達|つうたつ} is a directive from a ministry or agency to subordinate offices interpreting or implementing law. In business, it refers to company-wide notices from management.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通達|つうたつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to issue a directive
- {通達|つうたつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従|したが}う→従う：02059_shitagau⟧: to follow a directive
- {通達|つうたつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧: a directive arrives
- {通達|つうたつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to notify officially; to circulate a directive
- ⟦{行政|ぎょうせい}→行政：14122_gyousei⟧{通達|つうたつ}: administrative directive

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{通知|つうち}→通知：04061_tsuuchi⟧: notification; notice — more general, can be from any source to any recipient
- ⟦{指示|しじ}→指示：09674_shiji⟧: instruction; direction — a broader term for orders or instructions
- ⟦{公告|こうこく}→公告：24565_koukoku⟧: public notice — an announcement made to the general public
- {告示|こくじ}: official announcement — a formal public proclamation by a government body
